visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with long black hair and a pink tank top looks directly at the camera, initially appearing confused while smearing a pink lipstick broadly across her lips in an unrefined manner. The background is a brightly lit, slightly blurred indoor setting with white shelves. (2) She then uses a black circular powder puff to gently dab the area around her mouth, concealing the natural skin tone; her expression is focused and calm. (3) The character uses a thin white lip liner to carefully trace the edges of her lips, defining the shape with steady hand movements. (4) A close-up shows a hand swatching a glossy pink lipstick (PK-05) onto the fleshy part of the palm, demonstrating the texture and color against the skin. (5) She applies the lipstick only to her lower lip, then presses her lips together (mincing) and uses her ring finger to delicately blend the color outward for a soft finish. (6) The character poses, showing the completed natural lip look with a gentle smile and subtle head tilts; a golden heart-shaped earring is visible. (7) A new lipstick (RD-06) is swatched on the palm, showing a deeper red-pink hue before the character applies it to her lips and smiles widely, showcasing a more vibrant, hydrated appearance. (8) A third shade (BE-02) is swatched on the palm, revealing a nude-peach tone; she applies it and adopts a more sophisticated, 'intellectual' facial expression while resting her chin on her hand. (9) The video concludes with a close-up of a forearm with twelve different lipstick swatches labeled with text, followed by three lipstick tubes resting on a clean white surface.
